findings.explanation: Payment is due 90 days after invoicing, which significantly delays your cash flow and puts a strain on your working capital.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable Net 30 from receipt of invoice.

findings.explanation: Waiting 90 days for payment significantly delays your cash flow and ties up your working capital.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause "Invoices are payable Net 90.", payment is due 90 days after invoicing which delays cash flow; please update this to read "Invoices are payable Net 30 from receipt of invoice.". - Regarding the relevant clause "Payment period: Net 90", waiting 90 days for payment ties up working capital; please change this to read "Payment period: Net 30". Thank you for your understanding and I look forward to working together.
